label.zh: 提取果实：突破或被缠住

note.zh: 1400.b 之后本阶段要么突破进入空谷（1410），要么以每次掷骰 1.5% 的基础概率失败，探球被藤蔓缠住（1405）；1405 中再次焚烧时又可能失败为 1415。
note.en: After 1400.b the stage either breaks through to the Hollow (1410) or fails at a base 1.5% per roll and the Sphere is entangled (1405); burning free in 1405 may in turn fail into 1415.

label.zh: 研究空谷：未被发现或被发现
label.en: Studying the Hollow: unseen or noticed

note.zh: 1410.b 之后，要么隐蔽地观察生物（1440），要么失败被它发现（1430）。
note.en: After 1410.b the crew either watches the creature unseen (1440) or the stage fails and it notices them (1430).

label.zh: 焚烧生物：无限之根或全员殒命
label.en: Burning the creature: Infinity Root or crew lost

note.zh: 从 1425、1430、1435 选择“把它也烧了”后，突破得到无限之根（1450），失败则探球被根系占据、科学家死亡（1445）。1425 的“不要轻举妄动”会直接进入 1445。
note.en: Choosing “Burn the Creature” in 1425, 1430 or 1435 either breaks through to the Infinity Root (1450) or fails: roots fill the Sphere and the scientist dies (1445). “Do nothing” in 1425 leads straight to 1445.

label.zh: 持续研究：每一步都可能被发现
label.en: Continued study: noticed at any step

note.zh: 1440.b → 1455 → 1456 → 1457 的每一阶段都以 1435“被发现”为失败后备；坚持到 1457 可不用焚烧取得无限之根。
note.en: Each stage of 1440.b → 1455 → 1456 → 1457 has 1435 “Noticed” as its failure fallback; persisting to 1457 obtains the Infinity Root without burning anything.

note.zh: 在缠绕中焚烧藤蔓失败：探球半毁，船员全部遇难；获得大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Burning the entangling vines failed: half the Sphere melted and all aboard perished; a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 起锚撤离；获得一项生物学研究选项与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Pull anchor and leave; a biology research option and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 生物被火吓走，丢下一块会自行扎根、显出智慧迹象的根块；获得遗珍“无限之根”，探索结束。1451 是同一结局的另一入口（1440.a）。
note.en: Fire drives the creature away and it drops a root mass that takes root by itself and shows signs of intelligence; the relic Infinity Root; the exploration ends. 1451 is the same ending reached via 1440.a.

note.zh: 持续暗中观察，趁生物离开取走它埋下的根块；获得遗珍“无限之根”（另一版本标记），探索结束。
note.en: After long unseen observation the crew takes the root mass the creature buried; the relic Infinity Root (a different version flag); the exploration ends.

label.zh: 种下种子：植物化的科学家

note.zh: 1445 中科学家死亡，被根系同化；1800 天后其心智以植物类新身体恢复，作为年轻的领袖回归。
note.en: In 1445 the scientist dies, absorbed by the roots; 1800 days later their mind is restored in a new plantoid body and they return as a young leader.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1。它可能奖励遗珍，因此任一帝国正在探索时其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0；探索者未得到遗珍时解除锁定。
notes.en: Draw weight 1. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it; the lock is lifted if the explorer did not obtain the relic.

notes.zh: 原文差异：本篇中文标题作“行星物质”，英文为 Plant Material（植物物质）。
notes.en: Localisation difference: the Chinese title reads “行星物质” (planet material); the English is “Plant Material”.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 1400–1465 全部事件，补上九处 on_roll_failed 失败分支（1405、1415、1430、1435、1445），原独立故事 event-astral-rift-1405/1415/1430/1435 均已并入。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 1400–1465; added all nine on_roll_failed failure branches (1405, 1415, 1430, 1435, 1445); the former standalone stories event-astral-rift-1405/1415/1430/1435 are merged in.
